question: If two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, then which of the options below is not necessarily correct?

options.text: A pair of corresponding angles have the same measure.
A pair of interior angles on the same side of the transversal have the same measure.
A pair of vertically opposite angles have the same measure.
A pair of alternate interior angles have the same measure.
